difficulty_why: Requesting the restricted Gmail scope (https://mail.google.com/) mandates Google OAuth verification and an annual CASA Tier 2 third-party security assessment. Until approved, the app is capped at 100 test users and shows a warning screen.

dev_time.label: 15-30 min
dev_time.text: Time required to create a Google Cloud project, enable the Gmail API, configure OAuth consent screen details and test users, and generate OAuth client credentials.

launch_time.label: 4-8 weeks
launch_time.text: Covers domain verification in Search Console, Google brand and restricted scope review, and completing a CASA Tier 2 security assessment by an authorized lab.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom branding
own_app_reasons.text: Display your own application name and logo on the Google OAuth consent screen, which Google shows once verification is completed.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom scopes
own_app_reasons.text: Request specific or restricted Gmail scopes tailored to your agent's exact functionality rather than relying on Composio's shared defaults.

app_type.label: Web application
app_type.text: Web application (Private Client) is required because Composio handles authorization code exchange on its server backend and securely stores the client secret.

prerequisites.label: Google Cloud project
prerequisites.text: A Google Cloud account and an active project in the Google Cloud Console are required.

prerequisites.label: OAuth consent screen contact details
prerequisites.text: An app name, user support email address, and developer contact email address are required to configure the OAuth consent screen.

prerequisites.label: Verified domain and homepage
prerequisites.text: An app homepage and privacy policy hosted on a domain owned and verified in Google Search Console are required for external verification.

prerequisites.label: App demo video
prerequisites.text: A video demonstration in English showing the end-to-end OAuth consent flow, scopes requested, and app functionality is required for verification.

prerequisites.label: Security assessment
prerequisites.text: Apps requesting restricted scopes such as Gmail full access must complete an annual security assessment with an authorized assessor.

steps.label: Create or select project
steps.text: Sign in to the Google Cloud Console and select or create a project.

steps.label: Enable Gmail API
steps.text: Navigate to the API Library and enable the Gmail API for your project.

steps.label: Configure Branding
steps.text: Go to Google Auth platform > Branding (or OAuth consent screen) and enter the required app information.

steps.label: Configure Audience
steps.text: Select External under Audience and add test user email addresses for testing prior to public verification.

steps.label: Configure Data Access Scopes
steps.text: Go to Data Access, click Add or Remove Scopes, and add the requested Gmail, profile, and contacts scopes.

steps.label: Create OAuth Client ID
steps.text: Navigate to Google Auth platform > Clients, click Create Client, select Web application, and input the authorized redirect URI.

steps.label: Copy Client ID and Secret
steps.text: Click Create and copy the generated Client ID and Client Secret immediately into secure storage.

steps.label: Submit for verification
steps.text: When ready for production, submit the app for verification with a demo video, privacy policy, and domain verification.

scopes.label: Full Gmail access
scopes.text: https://mail.google.com/ (Restricted: full read, compose, send, and permanent delete access to Gmail; triggers restricted verification and CASA security assessment).

scopes.label: User profile
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile (Non-sensitive: see personal info including name and profile picture).

scopes.label: User email
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email (Non-sensitive: see primary Google Account email address).

scopes.label: Contacts read-only
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/contacts.readonly (Sensitive: read-only access to user contacts in Google Contacts).

scopes.label: Other contacts read-only
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/contacts.other.readonly (Sensitive: read-only access to other/frequently contacted people).

scopes.label: User email addresses read-only
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/user.emails.read (Sensitive: read-only access to user email addresses from Google People API).

approval.label: When required
approval.text: OAuth app verification and a third-party security assessment are mandatory before public launch when an app requests restricted scopes like https://mail.google.com/ and transmits or stores user data on a server.

approval.label: What's checked
approval.text: Google verifies domain ownership via Search Console, OAuth consent screen branding, privacy policy compliance with Limited Use requirements, justification of least privilege for requested scopes, and CASA security assessment compliance by an approved assessor.

approval.label: Wait
approval.text: Initial brand verification takes 2-3 business days, while full restricted scope verification and third-party security assessment typically require several weeks to several months.

approval.label: Cost
approval.text: Google does not charge for OAuth verification itself, but independent third-party assessors charge fees for CASA Tier 2 security validation, typically starting in the hundreds to thousands of dollars annually.

approval.label: Install cap before review
approval.text: Unverified apps presenting the unverified app warning screen are limited to a maximum quota of 100 new users in total until OAuth verification is approved.

approval.label: Limits until reviewed
approval.text: Unreviewed apps display an 'unverified app' warning screen to all users, are capped at 100 new user authorizations, and are blocked by default from Google Workspace accounts unless explicitly allowlisted by an admin.

pitfalls.label: Restricted scope security audit
pitfalls.text: Requesting the broad scope https://mail.google.com/ classifies the app under restricted scopes, triggering mandatory annual CASA security assessments by third-party auditors.

pitfalls.label: Permitted application types
pitfalls.text: Google only approves restricted Gmail scopes for specific permitted application types (e.g. email clients, backup, productivity tools); generic or non-conforming agents are rejected.

pitfalls.label: Annual recertification requirement
pitfalls.text: A Letter of Assessment (LOA) for restricted scopes is only valid for 12 months; apps must complete annual re-verification and security reassessment to avoid losing API access.

pitfalls.label: Configuration propagation delay
pitfalls.text: Updates to authorized redirect URIs or client credentials can take between 5 minutes and a few hours to take effect.

pitfalls.label: Redirect URI mismatch
pitfalls.text: Any difference in scheme, host, or path against https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add triggers a redirect_uri_mismatch error.

support.label: OAuth Verification Help
support.text: Google Cloud Platform Console Help Center documentation and support resources for OAuth app verification.

support.label: Verification Guide
support.text: Official guide covering brand verification, demo video, and restricted scopes security assessment requirements.

email_subject: OAuth Verification and Restricted Scope Review for Gmail Integration ([Product Name])
email_body:
Hello Google Cloud / Gmail Developer Support,

I am developing an AI agent product ([Product Name]) that integrates with Gmail through Composio ([Company Website]). Our application enables users to manage their emails by requesting the following scopes:
- https://mail.google.com/
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/contacts.readonly
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/contacts.other.readonly
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/user.emails.read

Our redirect URI is configured as: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add

Could you please clarify:
1. What specific evidence and demonstrations are required in our demo video for the restricted scope https://mail.google.com/?
2. Which CASA Tier 2 accredited assessors are recommended, and what are the typical review turnaround times?
3. While verification is pending, is there any expedited approval path for pilot Workspace or consumer testing beyond the 100 test user limit?

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Your Company / Product Name]
[Contact Email]

checks.label: Composio toolkit
checks.text: Composio has a toolkit for Gmail (`gmail`); Composio-managed OAuth app: yes; auth methods: OAUTH2

checks.label: Authorize URL
checks.text: Authorize URL is live and rejects an unregistered client_id, so you need a real registered app

observed.text: Navigating to the Google Cloud Console credentials page redirects unauthenticated visitors to a Google Accounts sign-in wall with an 'Email or phone' input and a 'Create account' option.

observed.label: Public documentation access
observed.text: The Gmail API documentation loads publicly without an authentication barrier and links to Google Cloud Console setup guides.
